questions.text: What does Aruzhan study at WKU?
questions.hint: "My name is Aruzhan Bekova. I study Engineering at WKU — it is my first year."

questions.text: Aruzhan slept in late on Saturday morning because it was the weekend.
questions.hint: "I woke up at half past seven — earlier than usual for a weekend!" — Aruzhan woke up early, not late.

questions.text: Who bought ice cream for everyone in the city park?
questions.hint: "Saule bought ice cream for everyone from a small kiosk near the fountain."

questions.text: On Saturday evening, Yerlan cooked ___ with chicken using his grandmother's recipe.
questions.hint: "Yerlan cooked rice with chicken — he learned the recipe from his grandmother in Semey."

questions.text: What did Aruzhan do on Sunday morning to help her roommate?
opts: She cleaned her room for her
She called a doctor for her
She helped her with a Chemistry assignment
questions.correct: She helped her with a Chemistry assignment
questions.hint: "I helped my roommate Meruert with her Chemistry assignment. She explained her problem and I worked through the calculations with her."

questions.text: Aruzhan went to sleep at midnight on Sunday evening.
questions.hint: "I fixed a cup of chamomile tea... and went to sleep at eleven." — Not midnight, but eleven o'clock.

questions.text: Aruzhan finished the ___ section of her Engineering Design project on Sunday afternoon.
questions.hint: "I finished the introduction section completely — something I had planned to do for two weeks!"

questions.text: What did Aruzhan do on Sunday evening?
opts: She visited the city park again
She called her family in Kyzylorda
She studied in the library for three more hours
She listened to a podcast and painted a watercolour picture
questions.correct: She listened to a podcast and painted a watercolour picture
questions.hint: "I listened to an English podcast about sustainable architecture and painted a small watercolour picture of the river."

questions.text: Where did Yerlan and his friends go on Saturday afternoon?
questions.hint: "We walked to the city park in the afternoon. We stayed there for two hours." — Yerlan tells Bekzhan.

questions.text: Yerlan learned his rice recipe from his mother.
questions.hint: "I learned from my grandmother. I practised it a lot last summer in Semey." — grandmother, NOT mother.

questions.text: Yerlan worked on his Economics essay for ___ hours on Sunday.
questions.hint: "I studied all day Sunday. I worked on my Economics essay for six hours." — Yerlan tells Bekzhan.

questions.text: What happened during the comedy film on Saturday evening?
opts: Aisha fell asleep during the film
Yerlan spilled his drink on the table
Saule laughed so hard she spilled her tea
questions.correct: Saule laughed so hard she spilled her tea
questions.hint: "Saule laughed so hard she spilled her tea!" — Yerlan describes the funniest moment of the evening.

questions.text: Bekzhan visited the city park with Yerlan's group on Saturday.
questions.hint: "I studied all weekend too — I never left my room. I only visited the cafeteria for meals." — Bekzhan stayed in his room the whole weekend.

questions.text: When did Bekzhan call his parents?
questions.hint: "I called my parents on Sunday evening. We talked for a long time. That was nice." — Bekzhan.

questions.text: Last Saturday, Aruzhan ___ her room from top to bottom.
questions.hint: "Last Saturday" = past time signal → Past Simple. clean → cleaned ✅ (regular verb, just add -ed).

questions.text: "Yesterday, Saule and Aruzhan walked to the city park together" is correct English.
questions.hint: "Yesterday" = Past Simple signal. walk → walked ✅ (regular -ed). Same form for all subjects — Saule and Aruzhan walked ✅.

questions.text: Yerlan ___ (practise) cooking at his grandmother's house every summer.
questions.hint: practise ends in -e → just add -d: practised ✅ (NOT "practiseed" — verb ends in -e, only +d!)

questions.text: Bekzhan ___ leave his room all weekend — he studied the whole time.
questions.hint: "last weekend" = past → DIDN'T (not doesn't). "Bekzhan didn't leave his room." ✅

questions.text: What is the correct Past Simple form of "study"?
questions.hint: study → consonant (d) + y → change y to i, add -ed: studied ✅. NOT "studyed" — must apply the y→i rule!

questions.text: "She didn't cooked dinner on Saturday evening" is correct English.
questions.hint: NEVER use -ed after didn't! → "She didn't COOK dinner." ✅ (base form after didn't — "cooked" ❌)

questions.text: On her way back, Aruzhan ___ (stop) at the market and bought apples and bread.
questions.hint: stop → CVC rule (s-t-o-p: 1 syllable, consonant-vowel-consonant) → double the p → stopped ✅. NOT "stoped"!

questions.text: Which sentence has the correct Past Simple spelling?
opts: "They staied in the park for two hours."
"They stayied in the park for two hours."
"They staid in the park for two hours."
"They stayed in the park for two hours."
questions.correct: "They stayed in the park for two hours."
questions.hint: stay → vowel (a) + y → just add -ed: stayed ✅. NOT "staied" or "stayied" — the y→i rule only applies when there's a consonant before y!

questions.text: What does "relieved" mean?
opts: very tired after a long day
feeling happy because a worry or difficulty has ended
questions.correct: feeling happy because a worry or difficulty has ended
questions.hint: "Meruert looked relieved and happy when she finally understood Chemistry." — the worry ended → she felt relieved.

questions.text: A "breeze" is a very strong, dangerous wind.
questions.hint: Breeze = a LIGHT, GENTLE wind. "The weather was perfect — cool, sunny, and with a GENTLE breeze." The opposite of a strong or dangerous wind.

questions.text: The opposite of "stressed" or "tense" is ___.
questions.hint: Relaxed (расслабленный) = calm and free from stress. "You look very RELAXED for a Monday!" — Bekzhan says to Yerlan.

questions.text: What does "gather" mean?
opts: to buy food at the market
to study very hard for an exam
to come together in a group
questions.correct: to come together in a group
questions.hint: "Four friends gathered in Yerlan's dormitory room for dinner on Saturday." Gather = to come together / meet up in one place.

questions.text: What is a "documentary"?
opts: A type of pasta dish from Kazakhstan
A film or TV programme that shows real events and facts
A type of music popular among students
questions.correct: A film or TV programme that shows real events and facts
questions.hint: "One friend suggested a documentary, but they all voted for a Kazakh comedy film." Documentary = деректі фильм — a real-life factual film.

questions.text: To "practise" something means to do it once and then stop.
questions.hint: "Practise" = to do something REGULARLY over time to improve your skill. "Yerlan practised cooking at his grandmother's every summer." — many times, not just once.

questions.text: "___, last weekend was a perfect balance of fun and hard work." — Yerlan.
questions.hint: "Overall" (в целом) = considering everything together; in general. A great word to start a conclusion sentence.

questions.text: What does "particular" mean?
opts: general and the same as everything else
special or specific, different from others
questions.correct: special or specific, different from others
questions.hint: "I want to tell you about one PARTICULAR moment from last weekend." — one specific, special moment, not just any moment.
